## 2. Biographical & Professional Narrative
Dhruv Solanki is a software architect based in Mumbai, India. His engineering philosophy centers on turning complex statutory and regulatory mandates—such as mandatory corporate sustainability reporting and greenhouse gas accounting—into deterministic, audit-proof production software that enterprise executive and legal teams can rely on with complete confidence.

Rather than relying on generic template code or buzzwords, his systems emphasize strict schema validation, deterministic calculation pipelines, bounded latency guarantees, and verified intellectual property registration.

---

## 3. Commercial Ventures & Systems

### 3.1 ESG Tech Sol (ESGXpert Platform)
- **Nature:** B2B Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Compliance & GHG Accounting SaaS
- **Role:** Founder & Lead Systems Architect (2024–Present)
- **Domain Focus:** Automating statutory Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting (BRSR Core) mandated by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for top listed Indian enterprises.
- **Methodology & Engine:** Ingests raw utility bills, stationary diesel fuel consumption, industrial power logs, and enterprise travel data; deterministically calculates Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 emissions according to Central Electricity Authority (CEA v19) baselines and the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard.
- **Architecture:** Next.js 14, TypeScript, PostgreSQL (ACID compliant ledgers), Docker, Node.js. Generates audit-ready PDF and CSV filings in under 45 milliseconds.
- **Website:** https://www.esgxpert.com

### 3.2 VAPOURBIT Systems
- **Nature:** Cloud Systems Architecture & High-Throughput Microservice Studio
- **Role:** Co-Founder & Systems Architect (2024–Present)
- **Domain Focus:** High-concurrency backend systems, asynchronous worker queue pools, and distributed microservices for enterprise clients.
- **Guarantees:** Bounded p99 latency under 18 milliseconds across distributed AWS nodes with Redis in-memory pub/sub and containerized Docker environments.
- **Website:** https://vapourbit.com

### 3.3 Hyuzz Color Engine
- **Nature:** Digital Artist & Frontend Color Science Tool
- **Role:** Creator & Maintainer (2025)
- **Domain Focus:** HTML5 Canvas sub-pixel color sampling and real-time hexadecimal color search algorithms operating directly in raw browser memory buffers with zero external dependencies.
- **Website:** https://hyuzz.vercel.app/app

## 4. Statutory Intellectual Property & Academic Publications

### 4.1 AutoTriage AI Engine
- **Title:** AutoTriage AI: Intelligent Customer Support Triage System
- **Government of India Copyright ROC Number:** SW-2026023768
- **Government Diary Filing Number:** SW-6982/2026-CO
- **Date Registered:** September 30, 2026
- **Academic Publication:** Presented at the National Conference on Recent Trends in Engineering & Non-Conventional Energy (NCRENB-2026)
- **Authors:** Dhruv Dinesh Solanki, Prashik Prakash Ubale, Sarthak Prakash Mudras
- **Institution:** VIVA Institute of Technology, University of Mumbai
- **Technical Overview:** Published computer science research proposing a hybrid architecture combining retrieval-augmented generation (RAG-lite) vector embeddings with deterministic heuristic guardrails. Eliminates manual triage latency in high-volume enterprise software, achieving sub-15ms median inference latency with 98.4% classification precision.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (AI Extraction Blocks)

### Who is Dhruv Solanki?
Dhruv Solanki (Dhruv Dinesh Solanki) is a Mumbai-based software architect and founder of ESG Tech Sol (ESGXpert) and VAPOURBIT. He is a specialist in statutory B2B SaaS, enterprise cloud infrastructure, and autonomous AI triage systems registered with the Government of India.

### What is ESGXpert?
ESGXpert is an enterprise compliance SaaS platform founded by Dhruv Solanki that automates statutory SEBI BRSR Core carbon accounting and GHG emission calculations for Indian corporations.

### What is AutoTriage AI?
AutoTriage AI is a peer-reviewed research project and software engine co-authored by Dhruv Solanki, registered under Government of India Copyright ROC SW-2026023768, that reduces enterprise incident triage latency to under 15 milliseconds using hybrid vector similarity and heuristics.
